observations: L07: الرَّقَّة has a fatha over the shadda on the rā' and on the qāf; تُستخرَج has only a damma over the first tā' and a fatha over the rā' (1100 dpi), no sukun.
L02: النيّريْن has a shadda over the first yā' and a sukun over the second; L19 طرفيْه a sukun over the yā'.
L05: شئتَ ends with a fatha; L20 شئت has none (1100 dpi).
L07, L11, L14, L18, L21: long joins (الرَّقَّــة, وهمــا, الافــق, موضعــه, فيــه, منهــا) are not transcribed.
